user.title: Connect to the Efilos VMC
user.description: Enter the address of the Controlador TS IP touch panel. Modbus must be set to TCP-ip in the panel's Installer → Communication menu (installer password 5678).

data_description.host: IP address of the panel (factory default 192.168.1.243), or of a router that forwards port 502 to it.
data_description.unit_id: Leave at 1 unless you changed it.

fans.title: Fan setup
fans.description: The sensor unit was detected from the current fan reading; check it before continuing.

data.speed_control: How the fan speed is set
data.fan_feedback: Unit of the fan speed sensors

data_description.speed_control: How you set the speed on the touch panel: a percentage, or speeds 1, 2 and 3.
data_description.fan_feedback: Only the unit of the supply and exhaust fan speed sensors. It doesn't change how you control the fan. Choose rpm if those sensors show values in the hundreds or thousands.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read from the controller. Check the address, that Modbus is set to TCP-ip on the panel, that nothing blocks port 502, and that no other Modbus client (such as a YAML modbus: setup) is connected: the panel serves only one at a time.
